title: Shadow AI in the browser
brief: 17:30. A free browser extension promises to write your email replies for you. It only needs a couple of permissions.
insight: An AI extension that can read every page can read your mailbox, the ERP and the bank. Free is how it pays for that access.
teaches: Read what an extension asks to do before you add it: “all your data on all websites” means everything
Check who is behind it: a publisher registered two weeks ago is not a vendor you have vetted
Use the approved assistant, or ask IT to vet a new tool

card.title: It reads everything now
body: “Read and change all your data on all websites” is exactly that: your mailbox, the payment run, the bank portal, all sent to a company that is two weeks old.
Shadow AI is not a bad tool, it is an unvetted one. The approved assistant can already draft replies.
